properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE BOUNDARY -- traced as the leftover open ground between the mapped street lines and neighbouring mapped shapes, rather than from a specific real parcel or building-footprint source; the pieces making up this shape were chosen and combined by hand. The small smoothing step used to bridge two internal walkway gaps may slightly overstate area at those two seams. IDENTITY: this shape is identified as the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center by four sources together: (1) Bright Horizons' own centre page names 'UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center' at 727 Nelson Rising Lane; (2) DataSF Registered Business Locations lists 'Ucsf Child Care At Mission Bay', owned by Bright Horizons, at 727 Nelson Rising Ln (certificate 0941054); (3) the City's address point for 727 Nelson Rising Ln (DataSF Addresses, address ID 743045, at -122.39330278, 37.76944026) falls inside this shape, about 2.7 m from its edge, and the nearest other mapped shape (Block 15B) is about 20 m away; (4) UCSF's June 2025 CAC presentation gives Block 18C's near-term use as 'Childcare Center'. Limits: the address point is a frontage point, not a building footprint, so it places the centre in this block, not this exact outline; 727 Nelson Rising Ln also carries other business registrations (a UCSF shuttle fuelling business), so the address is not exclusive to this building; and no source gives an opening date (the business registration's 2024-01-01 location start is a registration date, not an opening). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because the UCSF map treats this as an interim use ahead of a long-term 'Open Space' redesignation, not a finished build-out.
properties.notes: Sited immediately west of Sandler Neurosciences Center. Per UCSF's own Dec 2024-updated campus map (June 2025 CAC presentation), this is Block 18C, long-term planned as Open Space, with a childcare center as its near-term use. Operated by Bright Horizons as the UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center, 727 Nelson Rising Lane (Bright Horizons centre page; DataSF Registered Business Locations); see About this shape for how the address is tied to this shape. No opening date is sourced.
